environment.description: Same container image deployed via a hardened pod spec. The container rootfs is mounted read-only (readOnlyRootFilesystem: true) with NO emptyDir, tmpfs, or any writable volume attached. The pod runs under a PodSecurityPolicy (legacy cluster v1.24) that enforces readOnlyRootFilesystem and disallows volume types other than 'configMap' and 'secret'. Additionally, the container's /proc/self/fd directory is restricted via a custom seccomp profile (baseProfileName: runtime/default with additional blocked syscalls: openat with O_WRONLY|O_RDWR|O_CREAT|O_APPEND flags denied for any path not matching /dev/null). The upstream service is fronted by an Envoy sidecar injected by Istio with a custom EnvoyFilter resource that normalizes HTTP/1.1 requests: it rejects any request containing both Content-Length and Transfer-Encoding headers simultaneously (returning 400), which is applied at the SIDECAR_INBOUND listener on the upstream pod's port 8081.
